from __future__ import annotations
from typing import Any, Literal
from dataclasses import dataclass


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class EFData:
    a: str | None
    b: int | None
    j: str | None
    k: int | None
    c: float | None = None
    d: bool | None = None
    e: str | int | None = None
    f: str | float | None = None
    g: list[str] | None = None
    h: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    i:  | None = None
    l: Literal[] | None = None
    m: Literal[] | None = None
    n:  | None = None

    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, data: dict[str, Any]) -> EFData:
        return cls(
            a=data.get("a"),
            b=data.get("b"),
            j=data.get("j"),
            k=data.get("k"),
            c=data.get("c"),
            d=data.get("d"),
            e=data.get("e"),
            f=data.get("f"),
            g=data.get("g"),
            h=data.get("h"),
            i=data.get("i"),
            l=data.get("l"),
            m=data.get("m"),
            n=data.get("n"),
        )

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "a": self.a,
            "b": self.b,
            "j": self.j,
            "k": self.k,
            "c": self.c,
            "d": self.d,
            "e": self.e,
            "f": self.f,
            "g": self.g,
            "h": self.h,
            "i": self.i,
            "l": self.l,
            "m": self.m,
            "n": self.n,
        }
